subject.title: fix(security): add default pidsLimit for sandbox containers

question: Should OpenClaw impose a default Docker sandbox `pidsLimit` of 1024 on existing configs that omit the field, and what validated opt-out should remain available?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the choice changes sandbox security and availability defaults for existing users and needs maintainer security/product intent before merge.

options.title: Approve default cap with opt-out
options.body: Ship the default only with schema, type/docs, tests, and real Docker proof that define how users keep Docker-default or unlimited behavior when needed.

options.title: Keep PID cap opt-in
options.body: Leave current runtime behavior unchanged and improve docs or doctor guidance so operators explicitly configure PID limits for hardened deployments.

options.title: Replace with broader resource policy
options.body: Pause this PR in favor of a maintained resource-limit design that handles PID, CPU, memory, and zombie reaping together.

recommendation.title: Approve default cap with opt-out
recommendation.body: Ship the default only with schema, type/docs, tests, and real Docker proof that define how users keep Docker-default or unlimited behavior when needed.
